recipes.name: Giant Red Bean Bun inspired by Spirited Away
instructions: For the Red Bean Paste
Combine the beans and water in the bowl of a pressure cooker. - 2 cups adzuki beans rinsed - 6 cups water
Seal the pressure cooker and cook the beans on high pressure for 30 minutes. Allow the steam to release naturally from the pressure cooker. - 2 cups adzuki beans rinsed
While the beans are cooking, make the Bun Dough. - For the Bun Dough
Remove any scum from the surface of the cooking liquid, then strain the beans. Transfer to a food processor. - 2 cups adzuki beans rinsed
Process the beans in the food processor until completely smooth. - 2 cups adzuki beans rinsed
Using a rubber spatula, pass the bean paste through a fine-mesh sieve into a medium pan. This may take longer, but it's essential to the paste consistency. - 2 cups adzuki beans rinsed
Stir in the brown sugar and cook the mixture over medium heat until thickened to the consistency of a thick batter, about 20 minutes. - 2 cups brown sugar
Finish with a splash of oil to enhance caramelization. - neutral oil
Season the paste to taste with salt and allow it to cool to room temperature before using. - kosher salt to taste
For the Bun Dough
In a stand mixer fitted with a dough hook, add dry ingredients and mix until fully combined. - 560 g plain flour - 11 g instant dry yeast - ½ tsp salt - 1 teaspoon baking powder - 30 g fine sugar
Then add milk and combine into a shaggy dough, knead for about 8-10 minutes, or until a smooth pliable dough forms. - 320 g whole milk
Using your hands, form the dough into a ball and place in a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Set in a warm place and allow to rise for 1 hour, or until doubled in size. - For the Bun Dough
For the Red Bean Bun Assembly
Remove from the bowl and gently divide into 2 equal portions. Work with one dough ball at a time, rolling it out to circle around 8 inches in diameter. - For the Bun Dough
Once rolled, fill with red bean paste and trim any excess dough. - For the Bun Dough - 2 cups adzuki beans rinsed
Gently pull the sides up over the red bean paste, shaping it into a ball. - For the Bun Dough - 2 cups adzuki beans rinsed

Seal and pinch the top of the bun, tucking the pinched portions in. Cover with plastic wrap and repeat with the second dough ball and allow to rise for 20-30 minutes. - For the Red Bean Paste (Anko) - For the Bun Dough
Add 2 inches of water to a medium saucepan and set steamer baskets over top.
Place 1 bun per basket and cook, checking every 10 minutes until the dough starts to show resistance when poked. This may take a while depending on how even your stovetop is.
Remove and allow to cool for a few minutes, repeating the process with any leftover buns you make with the remaining Red Bean Paste and Bun Dough.
